summary:
“Stories From Space” is an interactive digital project created by Team The Losers for the NASA Space Apps Challenge. We have created an exciting story map which tells the story of four famous space explorers; the Apollo 11 Passive Reflector, Curiosity (Mars Rover), Voyager 1 and Pioneer 10.
This project answers the challenge by providing interactive stories to help people learn about the complex history of aerospace science. This is important as it helps us keep our curiosity alive, inspires young people and gives people a direct link to these little machines that have taken our biggest questions into space.
details:
What was created: Interactive story map showing 4 different space missions (Apollo 11 Reflector, Curiosity rover, Voyager 1 and Pioneer 10)

Benefits & Impact: Engage and educate young people through creating interactive stories about complex space history.

Tools Used: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub Pages.

Creativity: Story map has been categorized by how each mission is still working (active), stopped working (silent) or just passively there (passive).
